title: Bite-Sized Seattle History & Food by Go West Tours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The one and only tour of Seattle you'll ever need - in just 45 minutes.

Explore the city's rich history, stopping by world-famous attractions and many hidden gems. We'll stretch our legs, do food shopping in Pike Place Market - and build uniquely Seattle snacks that showcase local cuisine and history!

Guests love our tour because:
1) It’s intimate. We cap groups at 8 people, so it feels personal, not like you’re being herded around.
2) It’s efficient. You’ll be in and out in 45 minutes.
3) We eat awesome food. You won't stumble across it on your own.
4) Our guides are local. From the best sushi and coffee to where to grab a drink or how to get around, ask us anything. We’re happy to share.

By the end of the tour, you won’t just have seen some beautiful, iconic places, you’ll understand how Seattle’s past shaped the vibrant city it is today. Think of it as the most fun lunch & learn you’ve ever attended.

What We Stand For: Safety, Inclusivity & Adaptability on every tour.
